items.title: Meta adds high-impact brand ad formats across Facebook and Instagram
items.why: Ads Super Burst, First Impression Ads and expanded Reels Trending Ads give brand campaigns more guaranteed-attention inventory, so pricing and incremental reach should be tested against standard auction placements before budgets move.

items.title: Google Ads adds channel prioritisation and budget caps
items.why: Advertisers can now rank ad networks by priority and cap spend across channels including Search and YouTube, giving teams a practical way to stop automation from directing too much budget into lower-value inventory.

items.title: Google brings data-strength measurement into Demand Gen
items.why: The new uplift metric, wider Data Manager support and incoming enhanced conversions for DV360 and GA make first-party data quality more visible, so measurement setup is now a campaign optimisation lever rather than back-office plumbing.

items.title: Google Ads Editor 2.10 and earlier are no longer supported
items.why: Any team still running 2.10 or older must upgrade before bulk campaign work continues, making this a quick agency-wide version check rather than a troubleshooting surprise during peak season.

items.title: OpenAI launches always-on dots for proactive work
items.why: Dots can work across ChatGPT, Slack and Teams with a cloud computer and connected apps, making proactive research and multi-step operational work usable beyond a single chat, subject to permissions and approval rules.

items.title: Canva unveils Craft, its first in-house image model
items.why: An image model built directly into Canva shortens the path from prompt to editable campaign asset, so creative teams should test brand consistency and revision speed against their current generation stack.

items.title: Anthropic donates Agent Skills to the Linux Foundation's AAIF
items.why: Moving the standard to a vendor-neutral foundation with maintainers from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI reduces lock-in and makes reusable agency workflows more likely to travel across agent platforms.

items.title: Meta study finds 71% of surveyed APAC small businesses report an AI sales lift
items.why: The commissioned YouGov study included Australia and shows adoption is ahead of capability, with 86% wanting more guidance, creating a clear opening for practical ROI, privacy and workflow support rather than another generic AI pitch.

items.title: Australia's Children's Online Privacy Code is due by 10 December
items.why: Apps, games and websites likely to be accessed by children face additional privacy requirements, so audience data, profiling, personalisation and marketing defaults need review before the final code lands.

items.title: ACCC issues new guidance for emissions claims in marketing
items.why: Australian businesses promoting carbon or emissions credentials should now re-check evidence, qualifications and headline wording because broad green claims can create consumer-law risk when the detail does not match the impression.

items.title: NT Grow Your Business Tier 2 offers up to $20,000
items.why: Northern Territory businesses with a defined growth opportunity can seek $5,001 to $20,000 for structured improvements, with the current round closing 13 November.

items.title: NSW Quick Response Fashion Grants offer up to $10,000
items.why: Emerging NSW designers, textile makers and fashion businesses can fund essential equipment or professional development, with applications closing 19 November.

items.title: NSW EV fleet kick-start funding remains open on a waitlist
items.why: Eligible ABN holders with small fleets can still join the queue for vehicle incentives of $5,000 to $50,000 plus charging support, but the round can close before 30 November if remaining funds cannot meet demand.
